These six values replace the whole row. A limit left at zero is not left alone — it is cleared, and the identities it governed fall through to the next level.
A rule row overrides the global row fiel: A rule row overrides the global row field by field for this service, and only where its value is positive. A zero here does not switch a global default off — it leaves the global value in force.
The global row applies wherever no rule: The global row applies wherever no rule row overrides it. A zero falls through to unlimited unless something above it in the ladder applies.
The two halves of this bucket do not bou: The two halves of this bucket do not bound the same traffic. The request limit applies to keyless traffic only; the token limit is charged by every token-metered response on the service, credentialed requests included.
Every limit is zero, so this row would c: Every limit is zero, so this row would constrain nothing and the gateway refuses it. Set at least one non-zero limit, or delete the row to fall through to the next level.
